observed_reuse_and_gaps.implemented: Binary max(long_endpoint_net_pips, short_endpoint_net_pips)>0 at nominal two hours, with original alignment/cost assumptions.
observed_reuse_and_gaps.not_established: Chosen-side direction, intrahorizon survival, first-passage ordering, MFE/MAE prediction, conditional remaining-risk intervals or fresh confirmation.
observed_reuse_and_gaps.reusable: Direction-neutral endpoint opportunity target; purged temporal folds; train-prior, Brier, calibration and pair-level evaluation patterns.

observed_reuse_and_gaps.implemented: Both-side endpoint, favorable/adverse extrema and early/terminal weighted curve scores, using entry/exit open prices and M1 path high/low.
observed_reuse_and_gaps.not_established: Strict complete real path: old code permits up to 10 minutes alignment delay, requires only 90 path rows for two hours, and can infer missing bid/ask from spread or full-sample/default spread. Reuse arithmetic only with new strict provenance and missingness policy.
observed_reuse_and_gaps.reusable: Explicit bid/ask orientation and distinct endpoint versus path-extremum labels.

observed_reuse_and_gaps.implemented: Validation magnitude multiplier and residual standard deviation; retained probability is residual-logistic.
observed_reuse_and_gaps.not_established: Calibrated quantile coverage, conditional path risk, or calibrated probability that an incumbent remains profitable.
observed_reuse_and_gaps.reusable: Separate validation diagnostics and exact original native horizon metadata.

observed_reuse_and_gaps.implemented: Absolute movement estimator distinct from signed estimator, validation affine magnitude calibration and magnitude/current-cost gate.
observed_reuse_and_gaps.not_established: Affine magnitude is not a prediction interval. The newly corrected feature transform has no proven compatibility with old weights; the completed new MA comparison was negative in all nine directional cells.
observed_reuse_and_gaps.reusable: Keep movement magnitude and direction separate; evaluate costs and calibration on their own denominators.

observed_reuse_and_gaps.component: Existing curve contract and management bridge
observed_reuse_and_gaps.implemented: Original terminal interval translated to current-price remaining distance while preserving original target and conditional_recalibration=False.
observed_reuse_and_gaps.not_established: A translated original interval is not a newly calibrated conditional interval at the later management decision.
observed_reuse_and_gaps.reusable: Source/issue/consumption/target contract, interval field validation and pure management replay; avoid another bridge.

baseline_then_optional_model: Start with train-only empirical per-pair/horizon quantiles and a past-volatility-scaled distribution. Compare with fixed previous-window magnitude/ATR rules; disclose support rather than silently use sparse time-of-day cells.

Predeclare quantiles 0.10, 0.50 and 0.90 and their exact target variable. Keep endpoint distributions separate from MFE/MAE distributions; the existing terminal interval field cannot silently carry path risk.

Only after label and baseline verification, compare one compact volatility/range/activity/spread feature family with a bounded quantile learner under a new frozen development protocol. Do not rerun MA alpha selection or import old executable training wrappers.

An optional binary opportunity model may reuse the existing cost-survival evaluation design, but needs an actual fitted probability/calibration stage; no fake Brier metric on a point estimate or arbitrary 0.5 output.
evaluation: Chronological train, calibration/selection and diagnostic blocks with complete target-overlap purge; scaler and empirical distributions fit only before the relevant cutoff.
Report pinball loss, empirical interval coverage, interval width, magnitude error and underestimation/tail-loss rates against matched baseline origins. No nominal 80% claim without observed coverage.
For binary opportunity, report training-prior baseline, Brier/log loss, calibration bins, positive prevalence and balanced accuracy; do not emphasize raw accuracy under a large positive base rate.
Keep pair/horizon/side/label and source/cost-missingness denominators; retain all chronological UTC-date diagnostics. Correlated targets and pairs do not produce independent N.
If reporting descriptive bootstrap intervals, resample whole dates together across pairs and require at least 10 dates; no unadjusted multiple-comparison promotion gate.
No same-history follow-up is a fresh final test. A positive development result would justify prospective confirmation only.
proposal.first_milestone: Version strict path labels and score a fixed risk baseline before adding any learned risk model or management action.

labels.meaning: Absolute close-to-close return at exact native target; movement size without choosing a side.
labels.name: absolute_endpoint_return_bps

labels.meaning: Square root of sum of squared real one-minute log returns over the complete future path; finite observed variation, not instantaneous volatility.
labels.name: realized_path_volatility

labels.meaning: Separate nonnegative favorable/adverse excursion magnitudes from observed bid/ask OHLC and a declared hypothetical candle-close entry. No claim the best price was tradeable or reached before the adverse price.
labels.name: long_and_short_MFE_MAE

labels.meaning: Retain the old opportunity definition with explicitly versioned exact-target/actual-bid-ask costs. It is not a directional instruction or an oracle trading return.
labels.name: either_side_endpoint_after_spread_positive

management_use_if_later_validated: Use an independently scoped risk companion to assess movement versus observed costs, exposure limits and deadline choices in existing virtual management replay.
Do not convert an either-side opportunity probability into a long/short choice. Do not treat MFE as achievable return or adverse excursion as a fill price.
Do not change existing pilot nodes or append synthetic short horizons. Issue new risk evidence with its own version, feature/reference/availability/issue/target clocks and immutable source bindings.
No order, account, promotion or proof authorization follows from this design or from a favorable retrospective score.

scope.future_confirmation: Freeze any eventual candidate and its protocol before a separately collected prospective confirmation period.
scope.input: Existing immutable July 9–September 9 M1 captures; no new data acquisition in this task.
scope.time_classification: New retrospective development protocol. The same history and final period have already been inspected by the MA comparison; no untouched-test claim.

timing_and_path_policy: Reference uses completed origin close at its actual price clock (M1 label+60 seconds); exact target keeps the original horizon.

Exclude origin-bar high/low because those extremes predate the close-based reference. Use only subsequent complete consecutive bars through target close; include initial liquidation value explicitly when reporting immediate spread loss.

Any missing minute, missing real bid/ask field or conflicting duplicate invalidates the corresponding path/cost label. Endpoint-only labels may survive separately if endpoints exist, never disguised as complete paths.
No spread medians, inferred bid/ask, interpolated bars, rescaled row-time horizon, midpoint equivalence claim, or future extreme used as a predictor.
OHLC cannot establish ordering when both stop and take-profit levels occur in one bar. Such first-passage outcomes are ambiguous and not assigned a favorable order or broker fill.
All labels mature only after the final required bar was available; historical original ingestion remains unknown in retained CSV and therefore retrospective engineering only.

target_definition.description: Whether either side has positive endpoint pips after observed spread and static slippage.

scope: Bounded local source/report reads and opaque artifact hash only; no deserialization, fitting, scoring, runtime or source changes.
